title: Sei quartetti per due violini, alto e violoncello, dedicati alli Sigri. Dilettanti di Madrid, opera X
why_manual: BNE refuses scripted requests; only a browser can fetch it.
opus: Op. 9 (published as opera X, libro terzo)
incomplete_note: Only the second violin and violoncello part-books are present. V1 and viola are missing from the scan.
established_by: Hand-identified ('Opus 9 - Boyer, Paris - Incomplete (V2, VC only)'). RISM 990005865 is the same print -- 'Sei quartetti ... Dedicati Alli Sig-ri. Dilettanti di Madrid ... Opera Xa. Libro terzo di Quartetti', plate 517, [1790]. RISM lists no E-Mn holding for it, so the shelfmark is unknown.
rism_related_established_by: RISM 990005865 is the same print (Boyer, plate 517) but lists 21 holdings and no E-Mn; this BNE copy is not catalogued by RISM. Same edition elsewhere, not this copy. [claim.py, 2026-10-01]
